Holiday schedule for 2027

Next year the office observes New Year's Day on January 1, Labor Day on September 6, Thanksgiving on November 25 and 26, and Christmas Eve on December 24.

In addition, everyone receives two floating days to use at any point in the year. Enter them in Workday at least a week ahead, and check with your manager if more than two people on your team want the same day.

The full calendar is on the intranet under People and Culture.
